pretreatment: etched in HF to remove the native oxide, rinsed in de-ionized water after etching, ultrasonically cleaned in ethanol
evidence: The films for post-growth characterization were deposited on Si (100), Si (111), and amorphous silica substrates. Before loading the substrates into the reactor, the silicon substrates were etched in HF to remove the native oxide. Two different etching procedures were used to compare possible effects of substrate treatment on the ZrO growth. In the first case, the substrates were loaded immediately after HF etching. In the second case, the substrates were rinsed in de-ionized water after etching in HF. The SiO substrates were ultrasonically cleaned in ethanol.
